changes: Added AVC/H.264 and HEVC/H.265 profile, level, chroma format, bit depth, aspect ratio, and source format summary to route statistics.
Corrected HEVC SPS parsing for emulation-prevention bytes, sub-layer profile data, and chroma-dependent crop units.
Software updates now retain up to five uploaded packages and five installed releases, with retained releases available for rollback.
Updated the DeckLink Duo 2 SDI video-mode list to supported SD/HD formats and frame rates, including fractional rates.
Removed unsupported 4K SDI modes; Auto mode now falls back to a supported 1080p output when the source format is not supported.
